name: objective_rank
description: Objectives of a period, most important first.

aiGuidance.purpose: The owner's ranking for one period. List position is the rank: first is rank 1 (P0), second rank 2 (P1), the rest P2. Objectives left out are unranked, so their epics are parked.
aiGuidance.extraction: Reference objective records by instanceId in rank order. Reordering this list is the only way to reprioritise.
aiGuidance.negativeGuidance: Do not reference any other type, and do not set a Priority on the board by hand.
